facts.fact: Following its mid-term review, the PATN steering committee recommended proposing a date for validation by the Council of Ministers of the strategy "Vision Congo digital 2030"; the article gives no adoption. The review date is not stated, so the article's publication date is used.
The strategy is named "Vision Congo digital 2030".

systems.country_label: Projet d'accélération de la transformation numérique (PATN)
systems.owner: Government of Congo; steering committee chaired by Sylvain Lékaka; financed by the World Bank and the European Union
systems.tiers: national; US$100 million, about 40% disbursed per the article

note: Class is empty: the article names the Vision Congo digital 2030 strategy but does not describe its scope. Standing is validated on the article's wording that a date for Council of Ministers validation is to be proposed; it does not say the text is complete.
